segments.text: I met her at a matchmaking do, and she's got this thing about her...just being around her chills me out. No, not just that; it’s like she grounds me. And I’m gonna tie the knot with her, believe it or not.

So, getting hitched means getting busy with the birds and the bees, right? It took some serious gumption to face up to the fact that I'd be getting down and dirty with Mai-san. But was it all kosher? She popped the question, and before I knew it, we were picking out curtains.

And here's the thing, I can't get the little man to salute such an amazing, mature woman. She's a nurse, independent, and even has her own house (even if it's her family's). And I'm supposed to be her plus one? But...but this could be my one shot, my golden ticket. There won't be another person saying they want me and mean it.
...So, I'm gonna get hitched. Do the horizontal tango with Mai-san, and make some babies! Mai-san in the buff... Mai-san in the raw...
No good! I can't get it up—damn it!
婚活パーティに出るようになって、何度目かで出会った人で……なんていうか、一緒にいるとめっちゃ落ち着く。
落ち着くというか落ち着いちゃったよいうか、この人と結婚、するんだよな俺。
結婚するってことは、子づくりだってするわけで、麻衣さんとえっちするんだと一大決心して決めたんだけど。
本当に、オーケーしてよかったのか？麻衣さんの方から結婚を申し込んでくれて、なんかあっという間にまとまっちゃったけど。
俺、こんな素敵な大人の人に……勃起なんかできない。
看護師で、自立してて、実家とはいえ家まで持ってて、俺なんかが隣に立っていいのか？
でも……でももう、人生唯一で最後のチャンスかもしれない。こんなに『俺がいい』って言ってくれる人、絶対現れない。
……結婚、するんだ。麻衣さんと、えっちして、子づくりする！
麻衣さんの裸……麻衣さんの裸……。
ダメだ！勃たないーーッ！

「あなたとならきっとステキな未来を作れると思うの」

Aoi-chan probably can't stand me. At least, she seems to think I'm some kind of creep. It's the only way to explain the distance she keeps. From her perspective, an old guy like me probably appears gross and scary.
Still, it's kind of thrilling, in a weird way, how she shrugs me off.
No, wait. I shouldn't think like that. I'm her dad! Or going to be, at least! It's wrong to think of my daughter that way...
I wonder how other dads handle stuff like this?
Do they make any effort to get along better?
So, what can I do? Aoi-chan's a big help around the house. Maybe I can do something to lighten her load a bit...

A little angel, just perfect.
Man, thank God for sending such a cutie down to Earth. Or should those thanks go to Mai-san? I won't know which way is up when Kotori-chan hits her rebellious streak.

She's a bit like Aoi-chan, hanging back, but you can tell she's itching with curiosity. It makes me wonder if I gave her a little wave, would she come sprinting over? Just picturing it gets me all mushy inside. But hold up, let's think this out.

What's the dad's limit here? A little head pat's gotta be okay, right? It seems appropriate to lift a child of her age, doesn't it? When it comes to dressing... not sure if she's got that down yet. But I bet she can't quite get all her clothes put away afterwards. if that's my job, easy peasy. Heck, I might even help with bath time!
天使か。
もう神様、完璧です。こんないい子をこの世に送り出してくれてありがとう。あ、それは麻衣さんに言うべきか。
琴莉ちゃんがもうちょっと生意気な盛りに突入したら、ちょっともうパパどうなっちゃうかわかんないな。
遠巻きにしてるのは碧ちゃんと一緒なんだけど、興味津々なのがはっきりわかる。もしかしたら俺が「おいでおいで」したら、ててててーって駆けよってくるんじゃないだろうか。想像するだけで抱き締めちゃいそうなんだけど。
いや待て、よーく考えよう。

I want to touch her... to smell her... Just hearing her voice makes me...
Wait... she's around my age, and she's making me... really?
I've never experienced this before. Is it all about appearances, after all?
No, no, no, there's got to be more to it than that.
That... that potent sense of her being a little creature, the rising need to protect her... Maki-chan is anything but an adult. Yet, she's close to my age. Could she be my ray of hope?

"Meshi Daijin"
That's what they used to call Mikio back in his university manga club days. Over time, this nickname morphed into a pen name, giving birth to the Doujin creator, Meshi Daijin.

Mikio led a fulfilling life as an otaku, flourishing in the Doujin world, bringing illustrations and comics to life. His work, appreciated by many, made him a convention regular. Mikio embraced his love for little girls, a truth he acknowledged and incorporated into his life.
But a day came when he chose to renounce everything. His Doujin career, past works, the explicit art and figures he collected, and even his drawing tools were cast aside.
Mikio was set on steering his life in a different direction. Not much time had elapsed since that pivotal day, yet he faced a future he had never envisioned: getting married.
Translated and edited from the official site
「飯大臣」
――大学の漫研でそう呼ばれているうちに、成り行きでそれがペンネームとなって、同人作家「飯大臣」は生まれた。
オタとしてはそれなりに充実した人生だったと思う。
同人でイラストや漫画を描いて、おれの作品を好きだと言ってくれる人たちが大勢いて、壁サークルにもなって……。ちっちゃい女の子が心から好きだという自分を、おれ自身も認めて生きてきた。
だけどあの日――すべてを捨てた。
同人作家としてのキャリアも、過去の作品も、今まで集めたどエロい作品やフィギュアも、絵を描く機材すらも。
すべてだ。
違う人生を送るんだ……そう決めたあの日からそんなに時間も経っていないのに。
まさか自分が結婚できる日が来るなんて思ってもみなかった。
